question: What was the budget allocated in the Smart City Mission for the financial year 2023-24?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹8,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Smart City Mission** is a flagship program launched by the Government of India in **2015**.
 
• The mission aims to promote **core infrastructure, sustainable urban development, and a better quality of life** for citizens.
 
• The budget allocated for the financial year **2023-24** under the Smart City Mission is **₹8,000 crore**__.
 
• This fund is utilized for developing **100 smart cities across India** with focus on **smart solutions** like better urban mobility, improved sanitation, and efficient energy use.
 
• Under the mission, cities aim to use **technology, governance, and innovation** to address urban challenges.
 
• Projects funded include **integrated command and control centers, waste management systems, and smart transportation networks**.
 
• The Smart City Mission is coordinated by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**, ensuring efficient utilization of funds.
 
• The mission aligns with broader goals like **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** and India's commitment to urban transformation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **₹12,000 crore**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect as the allocated budget for the financial year **2023-24** under the Smart City Mission is **₹8,000 crore**, not ₹12,000 crore.
 
• ₹12,000 crore could refer to allocations under other government missions or programs in different sectors.
 
 
 
• **₹6,000 crore**__
 __
 
• The amount of ₹6,000 crore is lower than the actual allocation made for the **Smart City Mission** in **2023-24**.
 
• This amount might correspond to other urban development programs or regional initiatives outside the scope of the mission.
 
 
 
• **₹10,000 crore**__
 
 
• ₹10,000 crore exceeds the budget allocated for the Smart City Mission in the financial year **2023-24**.
 
• Although larger budgets have been allocated to urban development in India in the past, the mission-specific allocation remains at **₹8,000 crore**.
